data.title: Colors — Beginner · Lesson 3
data.subject: colors
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Come on, let's celebrate today!

[Hook]
Colors everywhere… Colores por todas partes  
Red, yellow, blue… Rojo, amarillo, azul  
We dance and sing… Bailamos y cantamos  
Birthday joy… Alegría de cumpleaños  
Under the sun… Bajo el sol  
Vivid orange… Naranja intenso  
Let's have fun… Vamos a divertirnos  
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres  

[Verse]
Laughter fills the air,  
we're spinning round and round.  
Happy birthday… Feliz cumpleaños  
To our friend so true.  
Light yellow… Amarillo claro  
Balloons are floating high.  
Sky blue… Azul cielo  
Like the endless sea.  
Mint green… Verde menta  
Decorations shining bright.  
Pale pink… Rosa pálido  
Cupcakes on the table.  
We cheer and shout… Gritamos y aplaudimos  

[Hook]
Colors everywhere… Colores por todas partes  
Red, yellow, blue… Rojo, amarillo, azul  
We dance and sing… Bailamos y cantamos  
Birthday joy… Alegría de cumpleaños  
Under the sun… Bajo el sol  
Vivid orange… Naranja intenso
